notes: Nine localized object-part episodes are reported. The pantry cabinet has two independently movable leaves; both are retained as separate events because both become open, although their individual transition order and final closing frames are partly obscured. Ordinary traversal through the bedroom entry door was not counted because a complete open-then-close interaction was not visibly established.
scene_description: A first-person traversal through an apartment kitchen, living area, utility and laundry closets, and a bedroom. The user opens and later closes appliance doors, a drawer, several cabinet doors, and closets.
